allowedCycles.why: PerfSpine builds its own command/event/service buses to record internal metrics, so perf depends on kernel while the kernel owns the perf spine. Breaking it means giving PerfSpine a narrow host interface instead of constructing a kernel; deferred, tracked here so it cannot grow.

Two entry points share the language listing and dump helpers. They belong in a lower slice (panel or a commands slice); deferred because both files are pure formatting and the move touches the installer.

budgetExceptions.panel/server.ts: the WebSocket switch plus the HTTP routes; splitting it further needs the handlers/ extraction finished (tracked since 0.7.9)
budgetExceptions.panel/WorkspaceService.ts: the workspace aggregate: languages, LSP, buffers and the registry mirror in one object. Splitting it is a design change, not a move
budgetExceptions.panel: the app shell is 30 files by nature (one page per UI plus its server side); the budget counts files, and this slice is the one that renders
